details.description: Claude Sonnet 4.5 is Anthropic's mid-tier Claude model, released September 29, 2025 for coding and for building complex agents; Anthropic reported it could stay focused on multi-step tasks for more than 30 hours. It supports vision, extended thinking and parallel tool use, with a 200K-token context window (1M in an available configuration). Anthropic has since released Claude Sonnet 4.6 (February 2026) as a full upgrade in the same tier, and Anthropic's own documentation lists a tentative retirement date of September 29, 2026 for this snapshot.
advantages: Scored 77.2% on SWE-bench Verified, averaged over 10 trials with a 200K token thinking budget, at launch (Anthropic launch post).
Led the OSWorld computer-use benchmark at 61.4% at launch, up from Sonnet 4's 42.2% four months earlier (Anthropic launch post).
Anthropic reported it could maintain focus for more than 30 hours on complex, multi-step agentic tasks (Anthropic launch post).
disadvantages: Superseded by Claude Sonnet 4.6 (released February 17, 2026), which Anthropic positions as a full upgrade across coding, computer use and reasoning (Anthropic Sonnet 4.6 launch post).
Anthropic's model-deprecations page lists a tentative retirement date of September 29, 2026 for this snapshot, matching the catalog's deprecation date.

notes: Catalog's deprecation_date (2026-09-29) matches Anthropic's own model-deprecations table, but as of research date that table still lists claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929 as 'Active' with only a tentative ('not sooner than') retirement date, not a confirmed deprecation with a named replacement row -- flagging in case the catalog's date needs to be treated as provisional. Catalog's 200K/1M input-token and 8192/64K output-token facts match the two configurations Anthropic describes (standard vs 1M-context beta).
